security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Point-cloud tree labelling, forest inventory and biomass from terrestrial and mobile laser scans
bundle.longDescription: PointCloudLabeler — Point-cloud tree labelling, forest inventory and biomass from terrestrial and mobile laser scans. Desktop editor for segmenting trees from large point clouds (TLS/MLS/ULS/ALS) and computing forest-inventory metrics (DBH, height, basal area, …) on top of the per-tree point data.
